reports.headline: Coins at the Bottom of the Mine
reports.body: The losers from the storehouse are being found in the old mine {dir} of the village {dist}, sitting in the dark counting coins that are not there. {name} brought one home. {they} will not stop talking about the next round.

reports.headline: The Luck Has Gone Sour
reports.body: Since the storehouse fights began, the mine {dir} of here {dist} pays out nothing but fool's gold. {name} says something down there is keeping the odds, and it never loses.
